item.title: Bushfires: Calmer Weather Helps, But 12 Major Blazes Still Burning
item.description: Firefighters in Victoria are taking advantage of cooler conditions to strengthen containment lines around a dozen major bushfires that have scorched vast tracts of land, destroyed homes, and claimed at least one life.
